title: Bounded real Ribasim full-realization management bridge
purpose: Repeat the real Ribasim allocation-to-SWAP transaction bridge only inside a prospectively bounded profile where both the physical UserDemand source-level reduction and the conservative UserDemand limiter reduction are inactive by construction.

admission_precondition.meaning: The first bounded profile explicitly excludes physical UserDemand attenuation by level or low storage.

frozen_sequence: derive the 2 cm RM07 request from one accepted SWAP management checkpoint
convert the request to one real Ribasim UserDemand over 1000 m2
verify the real Ribasim accepted origin satisfies the full-realization precondition before advance
keep one initialized Ribasim instance untouched as accepted-origin witness
run candidate A and discard it
verify accepted Ribasim origin remains unchanged
run independent candidate B from the same serialized input origin
require allocation, physical supply and Basin endpoint replay
require allocation and physical supply both equal the original 2 cm request within frozen tolerances
feed candidate-B allocated and supplied depths separately into RM06
reject the first SWAP candidate, replay from the same checkpoint and commit the second candidate exactly once
hypotheses: The RM07 request remains exactly 2 cm.
The real Ribasim accepted origin satisfies the preregistered full-realization level and low-storage preconditions.
Real Ribasim allocates the full 2 cm request.
With the reduction mechanisms inactive by construction, real Ribasim physically supplies the full request over the one-day window.
Independent Ribasim candidates replay allocation, physical supply and Basin endpoint.
Allocation and physical supply remain distinct observed quantities even when numerically equal.
The real Ribasim allocation and supply can be consumed by RM06 from the same SWAP origin with reject/replay identity and exactly one accepted management commit.
failure_rule: Do not relax the full-realization precondition, scientific expectations or tolerances after execution. Repair only technical setup failures.
nonclaims: No claim that arbitrary UserDemand min_level configurations fully realize allocations.
Separate Ribasim instances remain a qualification transaction pattern, not a claimed production checkpoint API.
